Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

I was going through some modelling photos recently sent in, one from a retired man, and the other set from an adolescent girl. I was especially struck by the differences in the cover letters that they wrote: the adolescent girl mentioned growing up kind of an outcast and being made fun of for not being good-looking enough, while the retired man gave the opposite story and talked about always getting compliments on how they look. Who was often found unattractive?
A. The retired man
B. Undetermined
C. The adolescent girl
